name: Anna Fan
title: Life Sciences Student @ University of Toronto
bio: Anna is a second-year Life Sciences student pursuing a double major in Human Biology and Physiology. She is passionate about neuroimaging and enjoys exploring different health-related fields through volunteer and clinical work.

name: Kyoko Lin
title: Life Sciences Student @ University of Toronto
bio: Kyoko is a 3rd-year undergraduate neuroscience student in the Faculty of Arts & Science. She is also a research student at Sunnybrook Hospital, where she investigates the efficacy of concurrent TMS-fMRI-EEG in determining individual human motor thresholds.
